summary: OddOneGaming showcases an Echo Summons II banner pull session aiming to obtain copies of Talethia and Sleight. He breaks down Sleight's exclusive artifact, Shell of Gilded Doom, and explains its high value for Toxin teams due to boosting Poison Derivative Damage by up to 50 percent. After completing 300 pulls to claim wishlist rewards, he does an additional 10-pull and lands a rare triple Legendary pull featuring Ergander, Talethia, and Vicana. This pull pushes his Talethia to Inspire 4 and adds high-value legendary dupes to his roster.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: His exclusive artifact Shell of Gilded Doom ignores resistance, applies extra Toxin stacks, and increases Poison Derivative Damage by up to 50%.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Deals heavy Poison Derivative Damage via her Passive and Ultimate, gaining a massive damage boost from Sleight's exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Great Radiant damage dealer worth targeting in Echo Summons to push toward Inspire 5.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.note: Solid hero choice to build up Inspire levels through earlier Echo wishlist milestones.

tips: Unless you are a big spender, only pull up to the 300 milestone on Echo Summons II rather than pushing all the way to 800.
Pair Sleight's exclusive artifact Shell of Gilded Doom with derivative damage Toxin heroes like Serpentemis to boost team derivative poison damage up to 50%.
title: 💥 I HIT THE JACKPOT 💥My First EVER Triple Lego In A 10 Pull | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
